content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Philadelphia

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's official eligibility criteria and gather documentation of your education and verifiable project-leadership history before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® training course. Attend all required sessions from your Philadelphia location on a schedule that fits your work commitments. Active certified practitioners lead every class, ensuring real-world context and preparation aligned with the exam blueprint.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training hours, submit your formal PMI application with proof of education and project experience. Pay the PMI examination fee directly to PMI. Allow time for PMI to review and approve your application before you schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and review sessions—to reinforce core competencies. Schedule your computer-based exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Sit for the three-hour, 180-question PMP® exam and receive your score upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: PMP® certification is valid for three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through ongoing training, community involvement, and project work. Renew your credential before expiration by submitting proof of PDU completion and the renewal fee to PMI.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
